adjudication.rationale: The diff adds an infinite reload loop in `app/views/embed/loading.html.erb` (`setTimeout(... document.location.reload(), 30000)`), and `EmbedController#best` enqueues `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` whenever `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` is nil. This means that if an embed never becomes available (misconfigured settings, unreachable/invalid URL, readability extraction failure, etc.), clients will keep reloading the iframe and repeatedly hitting `/embed/best`, which in turn keeps enqueueing `retrieve_topic`. Although `TopicRetriever` has a 60s Redis throttle (`retrieved_recently?`), it does not prevent job enqueueing and still results in ongoing client-driven requests and periodic retrieval attempts with no terminal state.
